CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Country selector modal opens and closes via footer trigger
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: On any page, locate the country/flag indicator in the footer. Click it to open the country selector modal. Verify the modal opens. Close it using the close action.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The country selector modal opens immediately on click of the footer country/flag indicator.
The modal closes correctly and the footer restores to its previous state.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Selecting a country with a single language updates the site and shows no language selector
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open the country selector modal. Select a country that supports only one language (e.g. France). Confirm the selection. Verify the site switches to that country and no language selector is shown.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The site switches to the selected single-language country.
No language selector is displayed for single-language countries.
The footer updates to show the selected country name and applied currency.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Selecting a country with two language options displays the language selector
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open the country selector modal. Select a country that supports two languages (e.g. Switzerland). Confirm the language selector appears. Select a language and confirm.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The language selector is visible and selectable for multi-language countries.
After confirming, the site reflects the chosen language.
The footer updates to show the selected country name, language and currency.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Changing language on a multi-language country updates the site language
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open the country selector while already on a multi-language country. Change the selected language. Confirm the selection.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The site content and navigation update to reflect the newly selected language.
The footer updates to show the correct language.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Country search by name returns correct results
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open the country selector modal. Type part of a country name in the search field (e.g. 'Ger' for Germany). Verify matching countries appear in the list.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Matching countries appear in the list as the user types.
Selecting a result from the list switches the site to that country.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Country search by ISO code returns the correct country
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open the country selector modal. Type an ISO code in the search field (e.g. 'DE'). Verify the corresponding country (Germany) appears in the list.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The correct country matching the ISO code is returned in the search results.
Selecting the result switches the site to that country.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Currently selected country appears as the first option in the top section of the modal
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open the country selector modal. Verify that the top section of the modal shows the currently active country as the first listed option.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria: The currently active country is shown as the first option in the top section of the country selector modal.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Suggested country appears in top section only when browsing from a different country
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Access the site from a browser location different from the currently selected country site (ensure browser location permissions are enabled). Open the country selector modal. Verify the top section shows the geo-located home country as a suggested option.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The suggested country (based on browser/device geo-location) appears as the second option in the top section when browsing from a different country.
No suggested country is shown when the browsing country matches the selected country.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Bag rectifier appears when switching country with items in the bag
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Add one or more items to the bag. Open the country selector modal and switch to a different country. Confirm the selection.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Upon country change with items in bag, the bag rectifier modal or notification appears.
The customer is informed of any item adjustments due to the country change.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Footer displays correct country flag, country name and language/currency after selection
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: After changing country and language, check the footer. Verify the correct country flag, country name, language link (if multi-language) and applied currency are displayed.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria: The footer reflects the correct country flag (or no flag for HK, MO, TW if applicable), country name, language selector link and applied currency after any country change.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Geo-location fallback — unsupported or failed location
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Simulate a geo-location failure or set device location to an unsupported country. Access the site. Observe what country/language is applied.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: The site falls back to a default locale when geo-location fails or returns an unsupported country, without crashing or showing an error to the user.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: G2-17733 AC references: 'Given geolocation fails or returns unsupported, server redirects to default locale' — ticket closed; verify fallback is still in place

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Flag display for HK, MO, TW — political flag exception
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Open the country selector and select or search for Hong Kong (HK), Macau (MO), or Taiwan (TW). Observe whether a flag icon is displayed.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: No national flag is displayed for HK, MO, and TW per the legal decision noted in the Epic scope. A placeholder or neutral icon appears instead.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Impact: Medium — legal/compliance risk if a flag is shown
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: Epic description: 'check any exceptions apply, e.g.: HK, MO, TW' — legal decision TBC at ticket creation

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Country search edge case — accented characters and partial ISO code
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: In the country selector search, type an accented country name (e.g. 'Österreich' for Austria) and a partial ISO (e.g. 'AT'). Observe results.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Search handles accented characters gracefully and partial ISO codes return relevant results without showing an empty state or error.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: No specific AC for character encoding in search — exploratory edge case

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Suggested country persistence — does the suggested country update if browser location changes mid-session?
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Start a session with geo-location set to country A. Open the country selector and note the suggested country. Simulate a location change to country B without reloading. Re-open the selector.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Suggested country reflects the initial session geo-location value consistently, or updates gracefully, without errors.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: PR #355 resolved hardcoded suggested country; dynamic geo behaviour not fully specified in AC

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Multiple language options (3+) — descoped for migration; confirm no broken state
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: If any country in the selector is configured with 3+ languages, observe whether the selector displays correctly or breaks.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Either only 1 or 2 language options are presented to the user, or the selector handles 3+ gracefully without error. No unhandled error state.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Impact: Medium — if backend configures 3+ languages the FE may show unexpected behaviour
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: Pardip Gahir (QA, 2026-02-24): '3+ language support not included for migration go live'
